evaluation.comparison_scope: Compare A-D only on predeclared common v2 question projection; report native Q1-Q6 separately
evaluation.first_release: Exact finite assisted-scope acceptance with supported positive and negative cases and correctly localized unknowns
nonclaims: Fixtures do not estimate population accuracy
Replayed semantics are not independent evidence

external_dependencies.blocks: Evidence and release; engineering can proceed
Only questions depending on missing authority/agreement/amendment
Actual-event conclusions; hypothetical profiles remain conditional
Automatic/general promotion, not scoped assisted acceptance

controller.behavior: Reuse existing locks, durable budgets and receipts; register explicit handlers only; no shell execution from program data

resources.network_plan: Use retained sources first; count all new requests in existing durable ledger
resources.default_compute: CPU only; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=-1 before framework imports
resources.bounds_status: Convenience workload caps; not statistical sample sizes or correctness thresholds

command_policy.note: Future prefix is a proposal, not an installed permission rule or executable. Existing OS/sandbox restrictions still apply.
